integrity_notes: New claim is the exact Bessel Euclidean area law, its strict monotonicity, and sharp exponential rate beyond the contracting subfamily. Finite numerical samples are checks, not proofs; no assertion of independent certification or absolute publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Specific cubic polynomial subfamily with lambda,a,omega strictly positive; this does not establish area laws for general homogeneous star-node systems. The prior exact angular return, period, Floquet results and existence criteria are credited; an equivalent unindexed area computation may exist. The large-anisotropy asymptotic is at fixed positive lambda,a,omega.
title: Exponentially expanding cycle area with fixed period and Floquet multiplier in a cubic star-node flow
